raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 was re-delivered at 2026-01-18 05:00, so 327 raw txn_ids appear twice, differing only in ingest_ts; the silver step does not deduplicate, which causes the duplicate keys and the inflated 2026-01-17 volume. Deduplicating on txn_id after the POSTED filter, keeping the latest ingest_ts, restores one row per transaction, and the gold tables rebuild from the corrected silver table.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC) = 1;"}}
